$note: 福德宮（2026-10-12）：福德通則。《深造講義》下篇 宮垣論 福德宮 p.560–575。弱智、自閉、心理不正常、變態、好色、淫濫、偽善、小器、鄙吝一類標籤不用；疾病、婚姻刑克、嫖賭飲吹不用；天姚、天刑、天月、華蓋、龍池鳳閣等引擎冇嘅星不用；要分日夜生、廟陷嘅條文暫不用。

rules.text: 火星在福德宮，精神較浮躁不安。
rules.en: With Huo Xing in the Wellbeing Palace, your mind tends to be restless.

source.quote: 火星及铃星入[福德宫]各主精神浮躁不安

rules.text: 鈴星在福德宮，內心容易焦慮。
rules.en: With Ling Xing in the Wellbeing Palace, you are prone to inner anxiety.
With Qing Yang in the Wellbeing Palace, you take on a great deal.
With Tuo Luo in the Wellbeing Palace, you worry a great deal.

rules.text: 地空地劫在福德宮，有時主思想獨特，未必不吉。
rules.en: Di Kong or Di Jie in the Wellbeing Palace can mean an original mind, which is not necessarily a bad thing.

rules.text: 祿存在福德宮，雖然欠衝勁，卻安樂。
rules.en: Lu Cun in the Wellbeing Palace: not much drive, but contentment.

rules.text: 天魁或天鉞在福德宮，有人照顧。
rules.en: With Tian Kui or Tian Yue in the Wellbeing Palace, someone looks out for you.

rules.text: 文昌文曲在福德宮，是福德宮最喜歡的星，主聰明才智。
rules.en: Wen Chang or Wen Qu are the stars the Wellbeing Palace welcomes most, pointing to intelligence and talent.
